bitRanges.name: Page Number
bitRanges.description: 0x00-0x1F selects a specific page; 0xFF applies to all pages (broadcast)

bitRanges.name: Output On/Off
bitRanges.description: 1 = Output ON, 0 = Output OFF

bitRanges.name: Turn Off Behavior
bitRanges.description: 0 = Turn off immediately, 1 = Use TOFF_DELAY/TOFF_FALL; ignored if bit 7 = 1

bitRanges.name: Voltage Command Source
bitRanges.description: 00 = VOUT_COMMAND, 01 = VOUT_MARGIN_LOW, 10 = VOUT_MARGIN_HIGH, 11 = AVSBus

bitRanges.name: Margin Fault Response
bitRanges.description: 01 = Ignore margin faults, 10 = Act on margin faults, others reserved

bitRanges.name: Transition Control
bitRanges.description: 1 = Update VOUT_COMMAND with AVSBus before switching, 0 = No update

bitRanges.name: Reserved
bitRanges.description: Reserved

bitRanges.name: Reserved
bitRanges.description: Reserved for future use

bitRanges.name: Startup Control
bitRanges.description: 0 = Unit powers up automatically when power is present; 1 = Requires CONTROL pin and/or OPERATION command to start

bitRanges.name: Use OPERATION Command
bitRanges.description: 0 = Ignore OPERATION command for on/off; 1 = Require OPERATION command to turn on

bitRanges.name: Use CONTROL Pin
bitRanges.description: 0 = Ignore CONTROL pin; 1 = Require CONTROL pin to be asserted to turn on

bitRanges.name: CONTROL Pin Polarity
bitRanges.description: 0 = Active low (pull low to start); 1 = Active high (pull high to start)

bitRanges.name: Turn-off Behavior
bitRanges.description: 0 = Use programmed TOFF delay and fall time; 1 = Turn off output as fast as possible

bitRanges.name: Packet Error Checking
bitRanges.description: 1 = Supported, 0 = Not supported

bitRanges.name: SMBALERT#
bitRanges.description: 1 = Device has SMBALERT# pin and supports Alert Response, 0 = No support

bitRanges.name: Numeric Format
bitRanges.description: 1 = IEEE Floating Point, 0 = Linear11/Linear16/Direct

bitRanges.name: AVSBus Support
bitRanges.description: 1 = Supported, 0 = Not Supported

bitRanges.name: Reserved
bitRanges.description: Reserved

bitRanges.name: Output Mode Type
bitRanges.description: 0 = Absolute mode; 1 = Relative mode

bitRanges.name: Format
bitRanges.description:
Specifies output format:
00 = ULINEAR16
01 = VID
10 = Direct
11 = IEEE Half Precision Floating Point

bitRanges.name: Parameter
bitRanges.description:
Format-specific value:
- For ULINEAR16: 5-bit two's complement exponent
- For VID: 5-bit VID code
- For Direct/IEEE: always 00000b

bitRanges.name: Response
bitRanges.description: 00 = Operate indefinitely; 01 = Operate until current drops below limit then use retry setting; 10 = Operate for delay time then use retry setting; 11 = Shutdown and use retry setting

bitRanges.name: Retry Setting
bitRanges.description: 000 = No retry; 001-110 = Retry N times (1-6); 111 = Retry indefinitely

bitRanges.name: Delay Time
bitRanges.description: XXX = Number of delay-time units (device-specific); used before retry or shutdown
